verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for automating deployment and pulling audit logs, so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths and a markdown version of the Teams API docs all returned 404. Having an API is a related feature, not a published machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
